boundary_evidence: NOT FROM tu_map. tools/tu_map.py does not segment the arm9 `main` module, so the boundary comes from the cartridge's own layout.

.TEXT: 0x0201577c..0x020171c8 is one unbroken run of the eleven dExt model and animation classes -- dExtAnmMaterial_c, dExtAnmTexSRT_c, dExtAnmTexPat_c, dExtFrameCtrl_c, dExtShadowModel_c, dExtCommonModel_c, dExtAnm2Model_c, dExtBlendAnmModel_c, dExtAnmModel_c, dExtSimpleModel_c (with the dExtModel_c root at its top) -- and the six _ZThn80_ destructor thunks. dClipper's C1 ends at 0x0201577c and dFdDummy_c (src/runtime/graphics/fader/d_fader.cpp, arm9/dFader_c) starts at 0x020171c8; nothing foreign sits between.

.DATA: the block 0x0208e738..0x0208e9e0, between _ZTV8dClipper and _ZTI8dFader_c, holds all eleven classes' _ZTI, _ZTS and _ZTV records interleaved with one another (the _ZTI run 0x0208e73c..0x0208e7ac covers ten classes in one stretch; the _ZTS strings and vtables alternate after it). It opens with data_0208e738, the textures-loaded flag dExtSimpleModel_c::AddToCommonModelDataArr reads. Eleven separate TUs would each have laid down their own records contiguously; one interleaved pool is one compiler output.

THUNKS: the _ZThn80_ pairs sit after every function, in the order dExtAnmModel_c, dExtBlendAnmModel_c, dExtAnm2Model_c. mwccarm emits ordinary .text in reverse source order and the generated thunks at the end in destructor source order; a ROM-descending single source reproduces both, which is what the emission-order check measures (115/115 in ROM order).

EXCLUDED: dExtFrameCtrl_c::LoadFile (0x0201794c) and the two UpdateFileOffsets statics (0x020468a0 dExtAnmTexPat_c, 0x020469ac dExtFrameCtrl_c) are outside the run, behind foreign classes, and keep their own manifests.

notes: One translation unit for the dExt model family, replacing the eleven per-class promoted entries (arm9/dExtAnmMaterial_c, dExtAnmTexSRT_c, dExtAnmTexPat_c, dExtFrameCtrl_c, dExtShadowModel_c, dExtCommonModel_c, dExtAnm2Model_c, dExtBlendAnmModel_c, dExtAnmModel_c, dExtSimpleModel_c, ModelAnimThunks). Their sources are this entry's legacy sources.

RTTI ON for the whole TU, as the cartridge was compiled: every class's _ZTI and _ZTS exists in the ROM pool, and the formerly RTTI-off classes' vtables now carry their typeinfo word instead of the zero romdata_check masked. Every emitted _ZTI/_ZTS/_ZTV is deadstrip-data with its cartridge home; this TU claims .text only.

DESTRUCTOR AND CONSTRUCTOR VARIANTS: each out-of-line ~X() emits D2, D0, D1 and each X() emits C1, C2. The cartridge homes D2 only for dExtModel_c, dExtSimpleModel_c, dExtAnmModel_c and dExtFrameCtrl_c (the classes whose D2 is reached by a derived destructor's base step); the other seven D2s and the unreferenced C2s (and dExtModel_c's C1) are homeless deadstrip rows. _ZN7Vector3D1Ev is a deadstrip-duplicate of its one home at 0x020072c0.

The six thunks are now ordinary licensed functions of this TU, so the deadstrip-duplicate rows the old per-class entries carried for them, and ModelAnimThunks' duplicates of the D0/D1 bodies, are gone.

dExtShadowModel_c::InitModel stays a C-front-end definition under `#pragma cplusplus off` (wall 6az, notes/mwccarm-codegen.md): a true Fix12<int> by-value body homes the parameters to the stack and grows 0x14 bytes.

No @NNN compiler-numbered symbols: the object defines no literal pools by name, so there are no defined_symbol_renames. The shared-header edits are comments plus one field name (BTP_File::numFrames in include/dExtAnmTexPat_c.h), neither of which adds or reorders a compiler-numbered object in any consumer.
